request.state: Each question quotes the text it asks about.

q1.instructions:
The text is "Planned upgrade of the booking service, Saturday night.

The window stays at the four hours we announced last month. Rehearsal finished
on time and nothing has been added to the plan. Bookings will not be taken
while the window is open. The desk will post an update when the service is back.
". The notice leaves the upgrade window at risk of running longer than the plan it announced before.

criteria.true: The notice says the window runs longer than the earlier plan, or the notice does not settle the length at all.
criteria.false: The notice says the window runs no longer than the earlier plan.
